mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) at the current point in time predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as elevated joblessness reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return is positive when UNRATE is above its 3-month rolling average, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as higher discount rates suppress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 60-day returns in late-cycle expansions is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through stronger economic momentum and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return is negative when INDPRO is above its 3-month rolling average, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1300 thousand units signal a strengthening housing market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and economic activity improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1300, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a high unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a restrictive monetary policy during a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint high FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates and reduced liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns in tightening cycles is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
